name: AD — Kerberos Brute Force Against a Single Account (4771 bad-password burst)
description: ≥20 Kerberos pre-auth failures with status 0x18 (bad password) against one account within 30 minutes. Complements the spray rule (which needs many accounts) by catching a targeted attack on one account. Expect near-zero noise once aml_srv/achuser/callcenter credential storms are fixed.
author: JCB Detection Engineering
query: event.code:"4771" and winlog.event_data.Status:"0x18" and not winlog.event_data.TargetUserName:*$
